verdict.rationale: Thoropass documents its own GenAI DDQ feature, including an "Autofill Automation for Questionnaires" and a way to upload previous questionnaires to a Library. That shows first-party AI questionnaire filling drawn from a knowledge base of past answers. The evidence is only article titles, though, and does not show answers being grounded in the customer's live controls, nor a draft-and-review workflow before sending. missing for 10: evidence that answers draw on actual controls/policies, documented draft review/approval flow, depth of autofill docs beyond demo titles, independent or hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As a sales lead, security questionnaires get answered by AI from my actual controls and knowledge base — drafts I review, not blank spreadsheets I fill
